definitions.gloss: encyclopedia; subject dictionary; reference work on topics
definitions.explanation: A reference work that provides detailed explanations of topics, concepts, and things (as opposed to a word dictionary). Organized by subject matter rather than by individual words.

examples.japanese: {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look it up in an encyclopedia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}{料理|りょうり}→日本料理：19425_nihonryouri⟧{事典|じてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an encyclopedia of Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{事典|じてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧つき⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This encyclopedia provides detailed introductions to animals of the world with photographs.

notes:
Distinguished from ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (word dictionary) by dealing with topics and things ({事|こと}) rather than words ({辞|じ}). Both are read じてん, so to disambiguate, {事典|じてん} is sometimes called 「ことてん」 and ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ is called 「ことばてん」.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}: encyclopedia
- ～{事典|じてん}: encyclopedia/dictionary of ~ (e.g., ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧{事典|じてん}, ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧{事典|じてん})
- {事典|じてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to look up in an encyclopedia

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: dictionary — explains words and their meanings
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary — the most common everyday word for dictionary
- {字典|じてん}: character dictionary — explains individual kanji
- ⟦{図鑑|ずかん}→図鑑：00437_zukan⟧: illustrated reference book — emphasizes visual identification

NOTE ON DISAMBIGUATION:
All three — {事典|じてん}, ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧, {字典|じてん} — are homophones (じてん). Context usually clarifies which is meant.
